rationale: UAL remains at the extreme top of its daily range (94.1%) with negative fundamental catalysts, supporting the original thesis of mean reversion. While the price has drifted slightly higher since entry, it remains well below the invalidation level of $104.90, and the 9-EMA ($103.85) continues to act as a support level that the price is currently testing. Given the high relative volume and the overextended nature of the move, maintaining the short position is justified until the invalidation level is breached.
